notes:
I reviewed all 40 people in chunk-2. The draft (a 40-record JSON array) passed node validation: every id comes from the chunk, ids are unique, names match exactly, required fields are present and each evidenceUrl appears in its sources. No verified record needed a phdYearResolution or phdInstitutionResolution. Bockstedt's institution is written differently from the chunk but is the same university. I used exactly 10 WebSearch calls (Ketter, Mehrotra, White, Ting Li, Goldsman, Shapiro, Chuck Zhang, Nazzal, Porter, Ratliff). Only Ketter's search led to a verification. The search tool seemed to drop personal names from queries, which made searching weak. Downloads are only in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-opsphdplacements/fb1f924e-51bf-54c0-8876-48cae82f06a9/scratchpad/fj-2/. Python that read downloads ran with -I. I wrote no repository file other than the draft.

HOW SOME PAGES WERE READ: RSM and Georgia Tech ISyE pages were read with plain curl. ORCID records were read through the public ORCID API (pub.orcid.org) but are cited as orcid.org URLs. Three CVs came through share or download endpoints with curl: Deichmann (SURFdrive /download), Mukherjee and Song (Google Drive). The Ketter Cologne page was read with WebFetch after curl timed out.

THINGS A VERIFIER SHOULD DOUBLE-CHECK (overlap and category judgments):
(1) Crozier: I recorded UK BEIS (government) starting Oct 2019. Her DPhil ran Oct 2016 to July 2020, so this job began about nine months before the degree. The ISyE profile places the BEIS year after the PhD. If that start is judged a pre-degree job, the answer becomes the CU Boulder postdoc from Sep 2020.
(2) Nemirovski: his first job, at the Research Institute for Automatic Equipment in Moscow, began Oct 1973, before his 1974 Candidate degree (month unknown). I left the category "unknown" because it is a Soviet state applied-research institute.
(3) Montreuil: he was on the UQTR faculty from 1980 to 1984, which spans his 1982 Georgia Tech PhD. Under the overlap rule I recorded Purdue (1984) as the first new job, but the rank there is unknown. The only source is the ISyE profile.
(4) Alexopoulos: the evidence is an ORCID employment entry at Georgia Tech from 1988-09 that carries his current title. Category is "unknown" because his starting rank is not stated.
(5) Deichmann: VU Amsterdam assistant professor from Nov 2011. His CV dates the PhD Oct 2007 to Oct 2011, while RSM dates the thesis 2012. I recorded phdYearVerified 2012.
(6) Toriello (USC Aug 2010, PhD Dec 2010) and Mukherjee (Brown Jul 2018, PhD Aug 2018): both appointments started before the degree date. The overlap is noted in each record.
(7) Mukherjee's Prager Assistant Professorship (non-tenure-track) is categorised other-academic. It could arguably be postdoc.
(8) Fogliatto: his CV lists academic positions only, so any non-academic job in 1997-98 would not appear.
(9) Kleywegt, Enlu Zhou and Ketter rest on employer biographies that date the first job to the PhD year. I found no CV for them.

I matched it to the GMU profile, which names his earlier service at Texas A&M-Commerce, Sultan Qaboos University and Qatar University.
